changelog: 🚦 Steadier paid models. When Kiro rate-limits an account, the proxy now tries it again after 5 seconds instead of a minute, and a burst of requests counts as one limit, so a model that only one account serves no longer goes offline for minutes. A request that Kiro calls invalid, such as an image sent to a model without vision, now gets its 400 even when another endpoint is busy, and the account stays in rotation.
